text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Classic Triple Crown under<n>her belt and an
impressive showing in<n>the Arima Kinen, Symboli
Rudolf sets<n>her sights on the shield of the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On returning to the waiting room, she<n>is greeted by
Air Groove, but the<n>vice-president seems
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she is the reason Air<n>Groove has
been running herself<n>ragged, Symboli Rudolf
resolves not<n>to skimp on her presidential duties.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the year comes to an end, it<n>seems that the
pair's desire to<n>lighten one another's burdens is
preventing them from seeing eye to<n>eye.
